g.text: DESIGN PREVIEW · NOT A LIVE CONNECTION
Same canonical profile. Candidate → test → confirm / rollback.
Active profile is never overwritten directly.
Configured topics · not a live traffic tree
ACK and RESPONSE belong to the same command ID.
Live topic feed needs backend support
The current API exposes diagnostics, not arbitrary message browsing.
No invented counts, retained flags or broker messages.
Custom publish is unavailable in the current API.
